notes:
- New: Performance Report - a full strategy tear sheet (Overview, Trade Analysis, Risk & Drawdown, Calendar & Sessions, Trade Log, Settings & Symbol) with Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, R-multiples, MAE/MFE and more
- New: export your Performance Report as a PDF, trade log optional (off by default, keeps it short)
- New: proper futures support - register a contract's tick size, point value and session hours under Data Center > Futures for correct $ P&L and slippage/commission in $ or ticks, not just %
- New: Total Net Profit $ next to Total Return % on the equity curve, with a toggle - the two can genuinely disagree on a volatile sequence
- New: click any (i) icon on the Performance Report to see exactly how that metric is calculated
- New: Optimize This Instrument - run a parameter search scoped to the symbol/strategy/timeframe on your current chart
- New: Long / Short / Both filter on the Performance Report
- New: Session Boxes indicator (Asian/London/NY AM/NY PM) and a ready-made NY AM Box Breakout strategy
- Faster: the Optimizer now runs combinations in parallel across your CPU's cores instead of one at a time
- Fixed: short trades were being evaluated with long-side fill logic in the backtest engine - now correctly filled against the candle's high/low the way an actual short position would be
- Fixed: Trade Log's cumulative P&L now sorts consistently by exit time
- Small polish: 1-minute data support, new Minute/Daily/Weekly/Monthly timeframe picker, per-line indicator colors, sortable trade tables
